bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM outputs using a custom proof-of-concept evaluation system (AnimaLLM) that prompts models with 24 structured query templates involving 17 different animals across 8 normative philosophical perspectives. An LLM-based evaluator then scores the responses from 0 to 100 based on their truthfulness (S1) and the degree of consideration given to the animal's own perspective (S2).
